purpose: Tagger tags assigned to the cards/illustrations of fixtures/scryfall/lightning-bolt.json, plus the full parent chain of each tag.
selector: oracle_tags: taggings[].oracle_id ∈ fixture oracle ids; art_tags: taggings[].illustration_id ∈ fixture illustration ids. Per target, tags sorted by (tagging has annotation / non-median weight first, tag has parents first, slug) and capped at 15 oracle / 10 art tags. Ancestors = transitive closure over parent_ids. taggings[] filtered to the fixture targets. Available per target: 4457ed35…: 5 oracle tags; 013e7eda…: 10 art tags; 2cb6200c…: 8 art tags; 58884d99…: 13 art tags; 928b4c38…: 8 art tags.
note: Tag records are the original Tagger objects except: (1) taggings[] is FILTERED (see selector) and the fixture-added key `taggingsTotal` gives the unfiltered count; (2) child_ids[] is filtered to tags present in this file and the fixture-added key `childIdsTotal` gives the unfiltered count. parent_ids[] is complete: every ancestor is included, so the file is a closed sub-hierarchy in which child_ids is still the exact inverse of parent_ids. `taggingsTotal` and `childIdsTotal` are NOT source fields.

records.label: meme
records.description: Cards that have become memes in Magic, or are explicitly based off of memes.

taggings.annotation: An iconic card, "Dies to Bolt" has been both a meme and a general test on a creature's usefulness.

records.label: burn any
records.description: Cards that burn any target: players, creatures, battles, or planeswalkers.

records.label: spot removal
records.description: Removal for one target specifically.  See also [sweeper](sweeper) and [multi removal](multi-removal).

records.label: single target instant/sorcery
records.description: Instant/sorcery spells that may target only one target. This is materially important for some effects that care about single targets. Not mutually exclusive with [multiple targets](/tags/card/multiple-targets).

records.label: facing away
records.description: Creatures looking toward the back of the piece, not toward us.

records.label: windswept hair
records.description: Hair fluttering in the wind dramatically.

records.label: artist signature
records.description: The artist's personal mark, identifying the work as their own. (Artist signatures might be cropped out in some versions of the same art.)

records.label: no one
records.description: Nobody is present in this art.

records.label: bisexual lighting
records.description: Pink and blue lighting on a scene. Doesn't necessarily imply bisexuality; the name comes from the resemblance of the colors to the bisexual pride flag. Compare and contrast [blue/orange](blue-orange).

records.label: loose lips
records.description: Depicts a subject with an open mouth (see Knight of the Kitchen Sink)

records.label: blue/orange
records.description: Features heavy amounts of the complimentary colors blue and orange, similar to a movie poster. Compare [bisexual lighting](bisexual-lighting).
